question: With a tilt that makes the live JO drive cross zero (LEVEL d < 0 vs 20 deg nose-down d > 0), does the DOWN20-minus-LEVEL leg-MN rate contrast contain a JO-attributable part (beyond the matched JO-withheld contrast) that is seed-consistent under each assignment, and do the assignments differ as predicted?

sources.step_c_code: malecns_backend.live.antennal_gravity_live (Trial.bind/step, pools, counts, pool_rates, body_angles, summarize, corr_matrix, sign_flip, label, complete, first_after, dn_groups), unchanged

context: identical to Step C: push-response N (hair-plate Step C A_ON, 20 live-v3 channels, tibia proprioception, no coxa channel, zero force); JO encoder on the four Step A sets; schedule proprioception 392 + hair plates 52 + JO 320 in every arm; JO withheld at the CNS boundary in OFF

tilt.LEVEL: model.opt.gravity left at (0, 0, -9810) for the whole run; recorded at every state; a tilt event with phi 0 and the unchanged vector is recorded at state 5005
tilt.DOWN20: after stored state 5005 is captured, model.opt.gravity = R_y(-20 deg) @ (0, 0, -9810) (gravity gains +x = 20 deg nose-down), held to the end

expected_operating_point.LEVEL: window d about -0.18 (Step C2 pre-tilt OFF d -0.161..-0.225; not measured after 500 ms without tilt)
expected_operating_point.DOWN20: window d about +0.17 (Step B geometry +0.195 at 20 deg nose-down; Step C2 10 deg DOWN posture terms ROOT -0.057, NECK +0.032)

tilt.rationale: smallest step expected to make d clearly positive given Step C2; inside Step B's +-30 deg grid; friction 1.0 >> tan 20 deg = 0.36; declared, not tuned

arms.duration: 20000 physics / 4000 neural transitions each; fresh process each; run once

integrity.I1_complete: all 37 arms COMPLETE with 20001 samples and 4000 ticks
integrity.I2_reproduction: REPRO_N0_7 equals the local N0_7 raw arm (sha above) by coxa_offset_yoke.reproduces
integrity.I3_common_rng: within each seed, all six arms have identical external schedule and per-tick uniforms digests
integrity.I4_prefixes: within each seed and assignment, LEVEL and DOWN20 have equal qpos and commands for stored states 0-5005 and equal fired lists for ticks with time_ms <= 500.0; within each seed, all six arms have equal state-0 qpos
integrity.I5_tilt_record: LEVEL: recorded gravity (0,0,-9810) at every state and tilt event vector (0,0,-9810); DOWN20: (0,0,-9810) for states 0-5005 and exactly R_y(-20 deg) @ (0,0,-9810) from 5006 on, tilt event with that vector; event OBSERVE_ONLY with the unchanged model record at 5005; no applied body wrench and zero external/generalized applied maxima at every state
integrity.I6_jo_delivery: JO delivered only in G1/FLIP arms and only to the four sets; OFF arms deliver no JO event; each tick's recorded JO rates equal zone_rates(recorded d, assignment); at the first tick with time_ms > 500.5, d(DOWN20) > d(LEVEL) on both sides for each seed and arm type
integrity.I7_seeds: every arm records its seed; tick-1 uniforms of seeds 19-24 are pairwise different

operating_point.O1: in every OFF arm, the mean of recorded jo_d over ticks with 520 < time_ms <= 2000, per side, is > +0.05 in OFF_DOWN20 and < -0.05 in OFF_LEVEL
operating_point.failure: INCONCLUSIVE_OPERATING_POINT, no labels; measured d reported; no rerun under this protocol

physical_precondition.rule: in every OFF arm, the angle between the Thorax body z axis and -gravity_hat stays < 45 deg for every stored state in the window

check_order: integrity, then O1, then the physical precondition

measures.pool_inclusion: pool has >= 1 spike in the window in any of the 36 seed arms
measures.rate: spikes in window / pool size / 1.48 s
measures.delta: Delta_a,s = rate(a_DOWN20_s) - rate(a_LEVEL_s) per included pool, a in {OFF, G1, FLIP}
measures.S: S_a,s = Delta_a,s - Delta_OFF,s for a in {G1, FLIP}
measures.rho: mean Pearson correlation of S_a,s over the 15 seed pairs; a zero-variance pair contributes 0
measures.sign_flip_test: exact over 64 sign vectors; p_a = #{rho_sigma >= rho_obs - 1e-12} / 64

predictions.P3: r_GF (Pearson of seed-mean S_G1 and S_FLIP) < 0
predictions.P4: for DNp73 and DNbe001, in each of the 6 seeds, the DOWN20-LEVEL rate contrast under G1 and under FLIP are both nonzero and of opposite sign
predictions.recording: each HELD or NOT_HELD by these rules; evaluated only when the status is INTEGRITY_ACCEPTED

reported_not_labelled: window-mean recorded d per arm and side
body: mean and peak tilt, mean pitch and roll relative to gravity in the window; first stored state where G1_LEVEL and OFF_LEVEL qpos differ
mean |Delta_a,s| per arm type and seed; L2 norm of S_a,s
per-pool seed median of S and the count of seeds with positive S
DOWN20-LEVEL rate contrast for DNp73, DNp18, DNg29, pIP1, DNbe001 per arm type and seed
tonic mean leg-MN rate over included pools, 0-500 ms, per arm type (LEVEL arms)
per-side (left/right) mean S, labelled with the reconstruction asymmetry; no roll claim

declared_interpretation.both_CONSISTENT_and_r_GF_negative: switching the active JO zone with tilt direction gives reproducible, assignment-dependent leg-MN patterns: the E/C routes act as a signed tilt-direction channel in this reconstruction; information structure a balance response would need; not shown corrective
declared_interpretation.one_CONSISTENT_or_r_GF_nonnegative: zone switching is not a simple sign flip (tonic history or the C route shapes it); reported as is
declared_interpretation.neither_CONSISTENT: a 20 deg zone-crossing tilt through this encoder gives no reproducible leg-MN pattern beyond the other senses over 1.5 s; causes not distinguished
declared_interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE_OPERATING_POINT: the C2-based estimate did not hold at 20 deg; recorded with measured d; another tilt needs a new versioned protocol

interpretation_limits: Modelled kinematic JO transduction; 120 Hz engineering scale; G1 label arbitrary.
Idealised step tilt by gravity rotation (floor and fly together, no rotational transient).
ON arms carry tonic JO input from t=0, so the OFF subtraction removes the other-senses tilt response only to first order.
LEVEL vs DOWN20 is no-tilt vs tilt; a generic response to tilting is removed only to first order by the OFF subtraction.
Passive neck sag (+0.033 in d, Step C2) is present in all arms.
Coxa MNs drive no joint; MN patterns are read out, acting only through the 20 admitted channels.
Right-side JO reconstruction far less connected; sets used as reconstructed.
No motor coordinate status change (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
single_run: All 37 arms run once after protocol, code and tests are committed and pushed; evaluated once.
